title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities Second Amendment Act 2020

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities Second Amendment Act 2020
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVI OF 2020
ACT XVI OF 2020
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA UNIVERSITIES
(SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Universities Act, 2012
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary,
4th March, 2020]
No.
PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills-90 / 2020/6273, dated 4.3.2020.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities (Second
Amendment) Bill, 2020 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa on 24th February, 2020 and assented to by the Governor of the
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 2nd March, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities Act, 2012
(Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. X of 2012) for the purposes hereinafter appearing:
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities (Second Amendment) Act,
2020.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills-90 / 2020/6273, dated 4.3.2020.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities (Second
Amendment) Bill, 2020 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa on 24th February, 2020 and assented to by the Governor of the
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 2nd March, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities Act, 2012
(Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. X of 2012) for the purposes hereinafter appearing:
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
2. Amendment
of section 48 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No.X of 2012.---In the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities Act, 2012
(Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. X of 2012), hereinafter referred as the said Act,
in section 48.-
(1) in
subsection (2),-
(a) the
word "and" as appearing at the end of clause (b), shall be deleted;
(b) the
full stop appearing at the end of clause (c), shall be substituted with a semi
colon and thereafter the word "and" shall be inserted;
(c) after
the existing clause (c), as so amended, the following new clause shall be
added, namely;
(d) "(d)
the Vice Chancellors of the Universities at Serial Nos. 25, 26 and 27 of the
Schedule-I, appointed under their respective Regulations shall continue their
services till expiry of their notified tenure."; and
(ii) after
subsection (2), as so amended, the following Explanation shall be added at the
end, namely:
"Explanation:---For
the purpose of this section "other legislative instruments" mean and
includes the Regulations promulgated under the repealed Article 247 of the
Constitution, repealed by the Constitution (Twenty-fifth Amendment) Act. 2018)
(Act No. XXXVII of 2018)".
